summary: AI has become embedded across nearly every knowledge-work surface in 2026, with roughly 75% of global knowledge workers now using generative AI and adoption nearly doubling in six months. The market is led by in-suite assistants from Microsoft and Google that reach hundreds of millions of existing users by default, followed by dedicated workspace, research, writing, and meeting-intelligence tools. Human verification remains essential as hallucinations persist across all tools.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365
tools.pricing_paid: Microsoft 365 Copilot approx. $30/user/month (annual); free Copilot chat tier available
capabilities: Drafting and summarizing across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams
Copilot Notebooks: AI workspace grounding answers in gathered files, chats, pages, and links
Audio overviews generated from notebook material
Agents and Copilot Studio for custom workflows
tools.best_for: Enterprises standardized on Microsoft 365 wanting AI grounded in their existing work

tools.name: Google Gemini in Workspace
tools.pricing_paid: Included in Workspace Business/Enterprise plans; Google AI Pro/Ultra consumer tiers from ~$20/month
capabilities: Default AI assistant across all Workspace apps (Gemini 3 model)
Drafting and summarizing in Docs, Gmail, Sheets, Slides
tools.best_for: Organizations and individuals on Google Workspace wanting embedded AI across email and docs

tools.name: ChatGPT
capabilities: Autonomous ChatGPT Work agent for multi-step tasks
tools.best_for: All-around AI assistant for writing, research, and analysis across any workflow

tools.name: Notion AI
tools.pricing_paid: Notion AI add-on approx. $8-10/user/month; Business plans include AI
capabilities: Notion Agent for in-workspace task execution
tools.best_for: Teams whose knowledge base lives in Notion and want AI over their workspace

tools.name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Google accounts; plan-dependent higher limits via Google AI Pro/Ultra
capabilities: Source-grounded research and Q&A with citations
Audio and visual overviews from uploaded material
Study guides and summaries from mixed sources
tools.best_for: Mixed-source research, citations, and study material with audio/visual overviews

tools.name: Perplexity AI
capabilities: AI answer engine with cited, verifiable sources
tools.best_for: Research workflows needing verified, source-cited answers

tools.name: Grammarly AI
capabilities: Writing assistance, grammar, and tone correction
Email and document composition (bundled with Superhuman)
tools.best_for: Polished writing and communication across apps for individuals and teams

tools.name: Otter.ai
capabilities: AI meeting summaries and action items
tools.best_for: Automated meeting transcription and notes for teams

tools.name: Fireflies.ai
tools.best_for: Sales and operations teams needing meeting intelligence across CRMs

tools.name: Glean
capabilities: Enterprise AI search across all connected apps
AI assistant and agents over work data
tools.best_for: Large enterprises needing unified, permission-aware AI search across their stack

tools.name: Fathom
tools.best_for: Fast, free meeting notes and summaries for individuals and small teams
